topArticle.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
topArticle.description:
After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millions
No one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane where they were going. The officers in charge would taunt them when they asked, they said. It was only when the seat-back video screens finally showed a map that the 18 migrants worked it out.

topArticle.title: Rebel offensive against Ethiopian army stokes fears of return to civil war

Fighting escalates after Tigrayan rebels form new coalition aimed at overthrowing Abiy Ahmed government
There are growing fears of a return to civil war in Ethiopia after an offensive by fighters from Tigray into the neighbouring states of Afar and Amhara and the formation of a new rebel alliance aimed at overthrowing the government of the prime minister, Abiy Ahmed.
About 600,000 people died between 2020 and 2022 during a devastating war between the Ethiopian army and the political party and paramilitary group the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Both sides are now accusing the other of triggering a return to open conflict.

topArticle.title: Hurricane Polo barrels towards Baja California region of Mexico
topArticle.description:
Area’s second-most intense hurricane on record being fuelled by exceptionally warm Pacific waters
Hurricane Polo is barreling towards the Baja California region of Mexico, the latest system in a Pacific hurricane season that has been notably active in recent months. On 22 September, a measurement of 892 millibars was registered for Hurricane Polo, making it the second-most intense hurricane on record in the east Pacific. It is fuelled by exceptionally warm waters across the Pacific Ocean, providing favourable conditions for the system to maintain its considerable strength.
Polo is expected to turn towards the west-north-west, before taking a more north-westerly trajectory on Saturday. It has maximum sustained winds of around 150mph, with even stronger gusts occurring within the most intense parts of the hurricane. Hurricane-force winds extend outward for approximately 40 miles from the centre, while tropical storm-force winds reach as far as 125 miles. These powerful winds, combined with torrential rainfall and dangerous seas, could have significant impacts. Although some fluctuations in intensity are possible over the coming days, Polo is expected to remain powerful as it tracks north-westwards.
 Continue reading...

The former foes met at a five-star hotel a few blocks from Trump Tower in Manhattan late on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN general assembly. The hotel is about 7 miles from the Brooklyn prison where Maduro has been held since he was snatched during a special forces raid on Caracas in January.

topArticle.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
topArticle.description: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.
topArticle.titleJa: ポーランド、スターリンク基地火災は妨害行為と断定 デンマークはロシアの脅威増大を警告
topArticle.summary: ポーランド政府は、ウクライナへのインターネット提供にも利用されるスターリンク基地での火災を妨害行為と発表。デンマークもロシアの脅威増大を警告している。

topArticle.title: Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage
topArticle.description: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.
topArticle.titleJa: 87歳女性の劇的な立ち退きがスペインの住宅不足を浮き彫りに
topArticle.summary: マドリードで87歳の女性が新たなオーナー企業の家賃を払えず立ち退きを強いられた。この出来事はスペインの深刻な住宅不足問題を浮き彫りにしている。

topArticle.title: Lidl banned from selling copycat Birkenstock sandals, Dutch court rules
topArticle.description: Lidl must also compensate Birkenstock and pay its legal fees, according to the court ruling
topArticle.titleJa: オランダの裁判所、リドルに模倣ビルケンシュトックサンダル販売禁止を命令
topArticle.summary: オランダの裁判所は、スーパーマーケットのリドルに対し、ビルケンシュトックの模倣サンダルの販売を禁止し、損害賠償と弁護士費用を支払うよう命じた。

topArticle.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on Russian billionaire
topArticle.description: Martin Ryan is pardoned months after he was jailed on charges of spying, but a second Frenchman remains in prison.
topArticle.titleJa: EUがロシアの富豪への制裁解除後、アゼルバイジャンがフランス人を恩赦
topArticle.summary: EUがロシアの富豪への制裁を解除した後、アゼルバイジャンがスパイ容疑で投獄されていたフランス人男性を恩赦した。別のフランス人はまだ収監されている。

topArticle.title: Eriksen leaves Wolfsburg by mutual consent
topArticle.description: Christian Eriksen leaves Wolfsburg by mutual consent, just over three months after collapsing during Denmark's friendly with Ukraine.
topArticle.titleJa: エリクセン、ヴォルフスブルクを双方合意で退団
topArticle.summary: クリスチャン・エリクセンが、デンマーク対ウクライナの親善試合中に倒れてから3か月あまりで、双方合意によりヴォルフスブルクを退団した。

topArticle.title: Is Burnham right to blame Russia for spreading online disinformation?
topArticle.description: BBC Verify examines Russian-linked operations spreading false information about the UK, Ukraine and other nations.
topArticle.titleJa: バーナムはロシアがオンラインで偽情報を拡散していると非難するのは正しいか？
topArticle.summary: BBC Verifyが、英国、ウクライナ、その他諸国に関する虚偽情報を拡散するロシア関連の活動を調査。バーナムがロシアを非難する正当性が問われている。

topArticle.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
topArticle.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.
topArticle.titleJa: 新たな野生ネコ科動物種が発見される - 生存個体はわずか1匹のみ
topArticle.summary: ボリビアで、これまで近縁種と誤認されていた斑点のある野生ネコ科動物が新種として特定されたが、既知の生存個体は1匹のみ。

topArticle.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
topArticle.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
topArticle.titleJa: 米国送還後、エクアドルが元大臣ホセ・セラーノを拘束
topArticle.summary: エクアドルは米国から送還された元「スーパー大臣」ホセ・セラーノを拘束。彼は重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面しており、法制度の適正手続きが問われている。

topArticle.title: ‘Pay-by-the-day’ living in Pereira: The forgotten survivors of Colombia’s earthquake
topArticle.description: In Pereira, Colombia, earthquake survivors living in pay-by-the-day rooms now face homelessness, overcrowded shelters, illness, and a struggle to be counted.
topArticle.titleJa: コロンビア地震の忘れられた生存者たち：ペレイラでの「日払い」生活
topArticle.summary: コロンビアのペレイラでは、地震の生存者たちが日払いの部屋で生活した後、ホームレス、過密シェルター、病気、そして公式に数えられないという困難に直面している。

topArticle.title: Watch: How toxic smog from wildfires is making Indonesians sick
topArticle.description: Around 175,000 people in Indonesia have suffered from respiratory illness since August.
topArticle.titleJa: 映像：山火事による有毒な煙霧がインドネシア人を苦しめている様子
topArticle.summary: インドネシアで山火事による有毒な煙霧が発生し、8月以降約17万5千人が呼吸器疾患に苦しんでいる状況を伝える映像が公開された。
